high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from a social media post by an account named "Tortured" with the handle @TorturedOrg. The post is titled "Sleeping sperm whales." The setting is underwater, with a deep blue ocean as the backdrop. There are several sperm whales visible, some of which appear to be resting or sleeping on the ocean floor. The whales are large and have a distinctive shape, with their heads pointing upwards and their bodies lying horizontally. In the background, there are two scuba divers swimming near the surface of the water.
